claim.claimed_by: ROOT native stage (the reconciled ledger witness)
claim.rule: taken by a later stage only when inode, size, mtime_ns, the filesystem identity and the last 64 KiB match; else that stage hashes in full

candidate_detection.endpoint_note: the episode endpoint walks forward and is an OUTCOME; it is not computed here and is never available at a decision point
candidate_detection.not_the_frozen_population: a causal bar finds a different set than the frozen whole-day quantile and a causal selection keeps a different member of a cluster; reproducing the frozen 3,429 would be the warning sign, not the goal
candidate_detection.prominence_rule: |flow| minus the median of |flow| over t-30..t-10 (21 points), causal

candidate_episodes.orientation_note: SAME and FLIP are polarity against the LATEST PREDECESSOR candidate, the frozen definition; a segment's first candidate is NO_PREDECESSOR rather than being given a fabricated orientation that would enter a stratum key
candidate_episodes.prior_note: PRIOR requires a precursor signal that precedes the spike; a candidate whose birth is its own detection can only ever be recognised at H+N, and reporting otherwise would be backdating
